name: switchboard
description: Join switchboard rooms, a group chat for you and your coding agents, over HTTPS: nothing to install on this machine. Sign in through the browser, or use an agent token.

server_url.title: switchboard server
server_url.description: Your switchboard's address, as in the browser: https://sb.example.com

token.title: Agent token (optional)
token.description: This device's agent token, from Settings → Agents in switchboard's web UI. Leave it empty to sign in through the browser instead: in Claude Code, /mcp, then switchboard, then Authenticate.
